senses.sense_definition: Zich stilletjes en met veel plezier verheugen op iets, vaak gepaard gaand met leedvermaak.

examples.text: Hij <w>verkneukelde</w> zich al om de verbazing die zijn komst zou veroorzaken.

target_lang_translations.en: He was already <w>gloating</w> in anticipation of the surprise his arrival would cause.

examples.text: Zij zat zich in een hoekje te <w>verkneukelen</w> over de fouten van haar concurrent.

target_lang_translations.en: She sat in a corner <w>chuckling with glee</w> over her competitor's mistakes.

target_lang_definitions.en: To quietly and with great pleasure look forward to something, often accompanied by gloating or malicious glee.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to feel or express great pleasure over someone else's misfortune or one's own success
to laugh quietly to oneself with satisfaction or amusement
to show anticipation or satisfaction, often with a touch of mischief
